regime: Metals and tech sold together: silver drops over 5% and gold over 2% while the Nasdaq slides
takeaway: Tuesday undid much of Monday's rally: gold fell about 2.3% and silver about 5.2%, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 86.8, which matches the forced-selling-in-metals and silver-under-stress patterns. Tech led stocks lower (Nasdaq down 1.5%, QQQ down 2%), matching the tech-led selloff pattern, though the Dow rose and the VIX ended nearly flat. Gold is about 12% below a month ago, so the short-term downtrend check still applies, with Wednesday's PCE inflation report next up.
